intent: Implement approved Dock design A: move the accent pointer into the selected cell, fill its allocation with selectedBg while preserving plugin status colors, reserve marker and padding space for stable neighboring cells, preserve one-row width bounds and classic shortcut hints, and update focused regressions and package previews.

findings.summary: Classic suppresses hints for short labels: the full-width cell count forces a 12-column reservation per cell. Reproduction with DockFooter.render at 30 columns/two short labels, 40/three, and 80/six omits enter open even though cells and a hint fit together.
findings.resolution: 4884f31 reserves hints from the current visible cells and actual short-label widths without reducing the visible count. New regressions fail on 0d80630 and pass at 30/2, 40/3 and 80/6; all 295 Dock tests and package typecheck pass.

abandonedReason: User rejected stretched equal-width cells after viewing a real wide-terminal screenshot and requested compact spacing; continue with content-sized selection cells in a new review change.
